title: YarraMate visual layout
description: Adapter-owned drag-position sidecar for one saved projection's canvas (ADR 0023). Never validated by Core, never routed through apply.

folded.description: The instances this view draws folded (#473). Written WITH the positions in the same document and always in full, never as a patch: a reader that half-applies a fold state draws a box whose contents are somewhere else on the canvas. Absent means the view's own `presentation.fold` decides.

unfolded.description: The instances this view draws OPEN even though `presentation.fold` says to fold them (#473). Two lists rather than one, because a reader who opened a box must not have it close again the moment the view's default is read back.
